Interface DocumentView<T>

Type Parameters:
T - the contents of the document
All Superinterfaces:
View
public interface DocumentView<T> extends View
A view that edits a file: a frame view, the application class of a single-frame application included. The framework gives it a Document, the commands of DocumentCommands, the save prompt on close and exit, a title that follows the document, and recent files.
